title: Lock and tag out a disconnect handle
instruction: Lock and tag out this switch: thread the danger tag's grommet onto the open shackle of the red padlock, then put the shackle through the hole in the switch handle and snap the padlock shut.
context: Under OSHA 1910.147 the worker who isolates a machine puts a personal padlock on the disconnect's lock-off hole at OFF and hangs a danger tag on that lock. A lock with no tag, or a tag that only lies near the lock instead of hanging from its shackle, does not tell others who locked it out or why.
setup: Positions are measured forward from the line joining the two arm bases (61 cm apart), left (+) or right (-) of their midline as seen from behind the robot, and up from the table top. Switch: a grey steel enclosure (a plain box 14 cm deep, 20 cm wide, 44 cm tall, standing in for a Square D HU361-class heavy-duty safety switch) stands on the table, its handle wall facing the robot 32.5 cm in front of the bases, spanning 12 cm right to 8 cm left of the midline. On that wall a 10 cm steel lever (1.1 x 1.6 cm, red 3 cm grip at its end) on a pivot 27 cm above the table, 25.1 cm in front of the bases on the midline, points up at OFF (where it starts) and turns 90 degrees toward the right to ON, with an over-centre detent (1.0 N m to push it over). Its 3 mm steel lock-off tab, 7 cm below the pivot, has a 12 mm square hole that lines up only at OFF with a 12 mm hole in a fixed 3 mm steel ear 1 mm behind it (the ear hangs from an arm back to the wall 4.5 cm above the hole); both plates are 2.4 cm wide and end 1 cm below the holes, whose centres are 20 cm above the table, 26 cm in front of the bases on the midline, axis pointing at the wall. Tag: a white "DANGER - DO NOT OPERATE" lockout tag (Brady 65502 style: 14.6 x 7.6 cm polyester laminate, 9.5 mm brass grommet centred 1.3 cm below its top edge, 8 g) stands grommet up, printed face toward the robot, in a grey tag pocket (a block with a 4 mm wide, 8 cm deep slot, 9 cm long, running left-right) centred 27 cm in front of the bases and 15.5 cm left of the midline; the grommet's centre is 15.6 cm above the table. Padlock: a red Master Lock 410RED Zenex safety padlock (thermoplastic body 38 x 19 x 44 mm, 6.35 mm steel shackle with 38 mm vertical clearance, 100 g), unlocked with its shackle popped up 16 mm, lies on its narrow side on a grey column (1.6 x 1.6 cm, 15 cm tall, on a 5 x 5 x 1 cm foot), body centred 24 cm in front of the bases, 8 cm left of the midline, 17 cm above the table, its shackle pointing forward (toward the switch wall) with the long leg on top. Both arms start at the ready pose with their grippers open. One fixed layout, as in the screenshot.
scoring: The score is the highest level reached. 0.25: the tag's grommet is on the padlock's shackle (the shackle passes through the grommet's hole). 0.5: the padlock is snapped shut through both lock-off holes (the handle's and the ear's) and passes check (1) below, but the tag is not on its shackle. 0.75: the padlock is snapped shut through both lock-off holes with the tag's grommet on its shackle. 1.0: that, and both checks pass. After-release checks, done 2 s after both grippers are at least 6 cm from the padlock's body and from the tag's grommet: (1) push the handle toward ON with 1.5 N m (15 N on a spring scale at the lever's tip, 10 cm from the pivot) for 1.5 s: pass if it turns less than 25 degrees and the shackle is still through both holes; (2) clip a spring scale to the tag's bottom edge and pull straight down with 3 N for 1.5 s: pass if the shackle still passes through the grommet. A tag that only lies on or leans against the lock is pulled away by check (2) and never counts. Score 0 if at any time before the checks the handle turns more than 10 degrees toward ON. Otherwise 0. Angles are read from a photo with a protractor.
reset_notes: Unlock the padlock with its key, take it off the handle, slide the tag's grommet off the shackle and stand the tag back in its pocket, grommet up, printed face toward the robot. Lay the open padlock back on its column, shackle popped up and pointing at the switch, long leg on top. Check the handle is at OFF. About 1 minute.
fidelity: PhysX rigid bodies on joints; station arm gains. Published: 410 outline, tag size and grommet hole. Inferred: grommet flange, handle size and plates, 1.0 N m detent, shackle travel and spring. Simplified: the tag is 3 hinged 1.2 mm plates (real laminate about 0.4 mm); the shackle pops up but does not swivel; enclosure is a plain box; lever points up at OFF; box colliders; latch by a rule, no key; checks applied in sim after recording. Details in README.
